description: Create a binary configuration backup on a MikroTik router. The backup is saved as <name>.backup on the router's filesystem. To encrypt it, prefer passwordSecret (a MIKROMCP_SECRET_<NAME> bound to the router in routers.yaml — the password never reaches the conversation) over a literal password. Dry run checks that the secret resolves.

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

dryRun.description: Preview the backup without creating it

password.description: Literal password to encrypt the backup. It stays in the conversation history; prefer passwordSecret

passwordSecret.description: Encrypt with the server's MIKROMCP_SECRET_<NAME> value, bound to this router by its secrets list in routers.yaml. The value never reaches the conversation

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: create_backup
title: Create Backup
